steps.decision: pass only when the normalized answer occurs in a returned title or snippet
judge whether a returned title or snippet supports the frozen answer; provider identity remains hidden
review disagreement or ambiguity without seeing provider identity

reference_domain_policy: Reference domains are withheld from automated and human judges until after the pass decision; they are diagnostic only and an alternative source can pass
abstention: If title and snippet do not contain enough evidence, mark unsupported rather than fetching full pages in the primary search-only comparison
freeze_blockers: model and immutable model version are unset
human disagreement procedure is not piloted
